lead_html: Integral has no G, so the pan has no fourth. Start with the first three cards: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: D Integral is a six-note scale: D, E, F, A, Bb and C. The fourth step, G, is missing. MAG Instruments lists the notes as D / A Bb C D E F A C and calls it one of the earliest handpan scales crafted by PANArt. It names the sound mysterious and introspective. Other makers tune their Integral a little differently, so check the notes on your own pan.
og_description: D Integral 9 handpan chords: chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
